content: For local-business SEO, implement JSON-LD schema.org structured data (LocalBusiness or most specific subtype available, e.g. ElectronicsStore/ProfessionalService) with name, address, phone, geo, openingHours, areaServed, sameAs (Google Business Profile/social links); JSON-LD is preferred over microdata for ease of maintenance; validate with Google's Rich Results Test; content must match visible on-page info.
